description: This file defines the SurveyResponses class, which extends the Basic class to handle survey response data in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for survey response attributes, methods for saving responses, sending emails based on survey outcomes, and creating related cases for negative responses.

classes.name: SurveyResponses
classes.description: Represents a survey response, manages saving responses, sending notification emails, and creating related cases for negative feedback within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the SurveyResponses class, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates that this class implements the ACL interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a survey response, sending emails, and creating cases for negative responses.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Prepares and sends an email to the contact using a specified template, and logs the email if successful.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates email templates with contact and case details to generate email subject and body.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs sent email details into the email system database.
